speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have read it. The title is the title. I am back on this side of the door, which is where I mean to stay until I am wanted.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Stay, then. The flag is up. The ground is already eating nuts. None of that is your business until a cue says it is.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The tireman has his pot. He can have you when I am done counting coats. A bare face on my stair is still a bare face. Keep it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He can have me when he is ready. I am not ready to be a face for the yard, and I am not going out to become one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Edith is in there with the hem. The stitch from this morning is the only news that coat has. Do not give it another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not give it another. Call me when the brush is the next thing. Until then I am a man in a passage.
